experiment: Conditional MDU real-model admission and matched mechanism test v2
previous_preparation: November9 draft expired before any remote deployment/training/generation/Judge. Original clock and incomplete code preserved; no model run or checkpoint is resumed.

clock.scope: New November13 real-model mechanism preflight plus conditional matched CE/MDU; no Nov9 model run existed. Includes all preparation, admission, training, evaluation, scoring and repairs without reset.

data.source: Same four admitted source patients and six fixed probes from corrected longitudinal v2. Four improving auxiliary patients are the first two reviewed non-panel patients per disease in source order.
data.auxiliary_role: Protection/calibration only; no replacement of original evaluation probes and no selection by model scores.
data.gold: Previously reviewed bilingual comparative phrases and official image pointers; prior independent patient/date verification incomplete. All patients exposed in historical T5:DEV only.
data.pixel_contract: Existing fixed per-image affine min/max rounded uint8 RGB; all28 image mappings checked exactly before model loading; two native ordered images/1152 visual tokens.

mechanism.R1: Question-only disease admissibility; normalized last-prompt input at layer21 down_projection concatenated with normalized ordered CLIP difference. Center from five training views, radius midpoint of maximum positive and minimum real-negative distance. Seven same-disease negative views per source, no probe features for calibration; nonseparation stops admission.
mechanism.preservation: Per-expert orthogonal basis of actual clean-Base autoregressive layer21 inputs from the three other editing sources and two same-disease auxiliary patients. Normalize the original activation before projection and do not renormalize the remaining evidence; numerical remnants <=1e-5 relative norm are zeroed. SVD cutoff1e-6, maximum640 predictor vectors.
mechanism.train_initialization: Same preserved MED state from corrected v2 for both CE and MDU; same rank88/7168parameters, optimizer groups lr1e-4/1e-3, gradient clip1, seeds and native/FIT cycle.
mechanism.MDU: 160updates/source, unchanged original MDU two-view/two-span robust objective at strength1/temperature1.
mechanism.no_other_changes: Original main150, standard comparator recipes and earlier results unchanged; no auxiliary clinical target answers are directly trained.

dependency_gates: Eight clean-Base generations with hidden activations; four old source Base token replays exact
Source-only R1 positive/negative separation and all20source/FIT routing correct
Four original MDU source deployments replay exact
Twenty projected original-expert protected outputs replay complete Base tokens before training; four projected native outputs are diagnostic only
After training forty protected outputs replay complete Base tokens, first-owner save/load token parity for each arm
All parameters/scope frozen before unseen paraphrase/probe feature extraction
comparison: Primary mechanism test CONDITIONAL_MDU vs CONDITIONAL_CE, sharing all new data/routing/protection/initialization/steps; shared-repair gains are not evidence of an MDU-objective gain.
metrics: Unchanged CORE native/FIT/unseen-paraphrase, three-class probe macro, joint native+three-state success, pre-correct retention and fixed UNKNOWN bounds; also routeON, same-state ON-and-correct and cross-disease routes.
claim_gates: Four native sources and eight unseen paraphrases all CORE-confirmed correct
At least one same-state probe is routedON and correct, so all-OFF does not qualify
Primary MDU probe macro lower bound exceeds matchedCE upper bound
uncertainty: Only4source and6probe patients, repeated probes across edited states; passing gates is an exposed-DEV signal, not independent superiority or clinical validation. Missing/unknown results remain in fixed denominators.
scoring: Existing CORE MEDPROP_SMALL4_CORE_FULL_SOURCE_V1, gpt-6-astra medium, exact accepted semantic payload reuse across all prior stages, inherited UNKNOWN preserved; one attempt per genuinely new payload, no automatic retries.
lifecycle: Existing libraries read-only. Preserve the new own-method conditional bank and an independent small local backup. No comparator reconstruction, raw-data downloads, historical deletion or extra recurring monitor. Finite resource guard plus collection/scoring/publication dependency.
stop: Any predeclared mechanical/data/protection/resource failure blocks dependent training/evaluation and preserves evidence. No test-driven radius/basis/step search or cohort backfill.
novelty_boundary: Scope classification and null-space protection are established ideas. This is a task-specific conditional-TT repair hypothesis, not an AlphaEdit/SERAC reproduction or an established novel/SOTA claim.

engineering_recovery1.reason: Inherited raw32 generator required a nonzero residual for every active hook, conflicting with protected zero residuals. Initial preflight stopped before training.
engineering_recovery1.changes: Task-local generator accepts zero only for explicitly projected experts; keeps exact prefill-once, active predictor trace and ordinary-expert nonzero checks. No parent runtime files changed.
engineering_recovery1.reuse: Reuse12 complete outputs,8Base hidden traces, frozen protection bases and R1 calibration. No pixel/role/geometry/optimizer/cohort change.
engineering_recovery1.registered_replay: One generation completed inside the old helper but its output was not returned/saved before the assertion. Exactly that named attempt is explicitly retried once with a new marker; original attempt retained and counted. No Judge or UNKNOWN replay.
engineering_recovery1.clock: Same original November13 start/deadline and500total-generation cap; no reset.
